acceptance: 17/17 PASS; read-only seal and member verification before comparison
hardware: UNVERIFIED; physical validation by real users after beta/release

reasons.E_CLASSIC: Classic RFCOMM is outside the BLE-only product boundary; the normal MainActivity forces BLE mode. No Classic pairing/retry/command path is shipped.
reasons.E_DFU: Vendor firmware transfer, bootloader, updater and OTA/DFU are outside direct bed control. Normal BLE name gates and meditation command availability are implemented separately.
reasons.E_PHONE: Android permissions, phone adapter enable/disable, scan-screen timing, broadcast/callback plumbing, UI/lifecycle and phone-only metadata are host-platform machinery. HA retains its existing Bluetooth adapters/proxies and manual setup; no phone-system administration feature is ported.
reasons.E_DEAD: The accepting audit proves no live constructor, selector, handler binding or visible ancestor path. Dead/unbound code grants no control or capability.
reasons.E_HIDDEN: Bound handler is permanently hidden by its effective parent/view visibility (C109 or C347); synthetic direct invocation is not a reachable user control.
reasons.E_CRC: CRC16 belongs to the dead P3 controller; no reachable normal BLE frame uses it.
reasons.E_INFO: Unused Device Information UUIDs/read helpers have no reachable normal-control read or parser; do not invent serial, battery or firmware sensors.
reasons.E_DISCARDED: Values are loaded only into discarded locals or an empty updateDeviceStatus helper. No reachable bed-position/state effect exists.
reasons.E_CLOUD: HTTP catalog acquisition is frozen evidence only. Online catalog refresh, cloud/account/auth/weather and network administration are outside the direct BLE integration. All 21 acquired local capability rows are implemented.
reasons.E_LOCATION: JNI/location/Android location-library behavior is unrelated to bed BLE control.
reasons.E_PERSISTENCE: JNI Realm persistence is phone application infrastructure. Explicit HA per-address/profile configuration replaces it without a bed command.
reasons.E_SELECTOR_BUG: Settings A/B strings yield side byte 00 because the builder only recognizes Left/Right. HA exposes the proven Left=02/Right=01 selectors and native Both; reproducing the mismatched strings would select an unintended side.
reasons.E_NAME_OVERFLOW: More than 16 UTF-16 units overrun the source 18-byte name array. Reject before any write; retain the source 16-unit checksum overwrite and non-ASCII byte truncation for valid-size input.
reasons.E_ALARM_INVALID: Past/same-time or ambiguous/nonexistent local one-time alarm targets have unsafe Android date/countdown behavior. Require future same-day unambiguous targets and validate both three-slot tables before any write; valid artifact vectors remain byte-exact.
reasons.E_QUEUE_BUG: The app queues repeated references to one mutable characteristic and disconnects after queue overflow, allowing later setValue calls to change pending movement. HA serializes immutable frames and binds cleanup to the original session, preventing stale motion after cancellation/reconnect.
reasons.E_PICKER: The phone bitmap picker, image density, out-of-bounds getPixel crash, Android fromUser/listener restoration and haptic/audio/countdown presentation are phone UI. HA RGB inputs and brightness preserve all reachable BLE color writes; HA automation can repeat the proven meditation start frame.
reasons.E_O5: The generic o5 preset tag is assigned/visible but has no command branch. No BLE action is invented for it.
